The ball shows significant signs of wear, with the white leather cover appearing dirty, scuffed, and brownish-grey rather than pristine white. The red stitching is prominent, raised, and follows the characteristic figure-eight pattern, though some threads appear frayed or worn. The texture of the leather is highly detailed, showing pores and creases. The background is a soft, out-of-focus grey.
